How an Ottawa man played 365 rec sports games in less than a year

On Jan. 1, Kenny MacDonald set a goal to play 365 recreational sport games in Ottawa before the year came to a close. On Sunday, he completed his mission at the Bell Sensplex in Kanata. The CBC's Emma Weller was there.
